hero.title: How does DocumentoIQ work?
hero.subtitle: DocumentoIQ transforms complex documents into structured, ready-to-use information through a process that combines technology, document logic and human validation.
hero.followup: From the original document to organised, reviewable information that can be integrated into your operation.

step1.heading: 1. Upload documents
step1.description: Start the process with digital or scanned files, or documents from other systems.

step2.heading: 2. DocumentoIQ analyses and organises
step2.description: Advanced OCR and Artificial Intelligence interpret the content, while document logic structures the relevant data for each workflow.

step3.heading: 3. Review and continue the process
step3.description: Validate the information obtained from the platform and send it to other systems or formats according to operational needs.
